tests.meaning: Exact shared native transport/Poisson axes and coefficients, Galerkin basis/quadrature, source consistency and rejection of independent solution grids.
Actual exact quarter/coarse/medium spatial manufacture, p4/p5 cost-error comparison and production linear5/RK4 fixed-space temporal refinement; finite screens are not continuum certificates.

Default linear5 production stepping, shape-trigger calibration without scheduled interpolation, cold recovery of the trigger reference and original adaptive check schedule (0.005 to 0.5 tau, checks are not triggers), original references/clocks and portable atomic native checkpoints; accuracy thresholds belong only to tests.

Exact stored nonuniform medium/half axes and metrics, active-only physical derivative closures, ghost independence, portable replay, and analytic scalar B_x full/interface fourth-order finite-pair screens.
Fourth-order complete-line derivative, constants and periodic RK4 stability with explicit sixth-order damping.
Sparse factorization versus modal reference on identical Galerkin weak equations and traces.
Static active-owner main wall-connected source-region geometry, subcell crossings and trigger support; no PDE evolution.

Shape-triggered same-time remesh, initial calibration without interpolation, cumulative region change and original adaptive check schedule (0.005 to 0.5 tau, checks are not triggers), independent patch transfer, clocks/IPC and cold reconstruction.
Three-grid nonpolynomial same-time transfer accuracy of complete W/q/F/Q against direct data on the identical new grid.
Portable configuration, declared method and structural option contracts; numerical accuracy is tested independently.
Gaussian authority generation, fixed original reference axes, selected configuration, portable manifest/MAT identity and provenance rejections; no PDE initialization integration.
Synthetic accepted-state stopping windows, complete F/Q regional gates, candidate invalidation and resume semantics; no physical steady solution or mesh qualification.
Exact public-state/context isolation, independent fresh-RHS tolerance and generic field sampling.
Short restart, portable identities, accepted-pointer transactions and read-only legacy imports.
Local polynomial, constant, reconstruction, velocity-Jacobian and CFL checks; not global accuracy.

Registered-Gaussian default configuration plus explicit expression-initialized FEM/linear5 entrypoint from a foreign cwd, Unicode output, immutable input and I/P/C, restart, all-stage CFL and native data identity; no trajectory accuracy qualification.
Short native run, exact zero initial residual, accepted-state stops, resumable stopping state and SHA-bound native field export; no steady-state qualification.
Current explicit time policies, mandatory prepared context and rejection paths; historical frozen trajectories are explicitly skipped.
Independent exact-source, streamfunction and velocity manufactures, including isolated patch refinements.
Structural, constant and polynomial assertions; raw static order measurements remain separate.
Independent centered-background arithmetic, kinematics and original-datum source reconstruction.
Same discrete Poisson systems and original backward-error gates; not a continuum certificate.
Independent initial dipole moment, Green integral, analytic derivatives and complete RHS identities.
Initial-state exact transport Jacobian and two gauge solvers on the same physical field; historical checkpoint explicitly skipped.
Protected geometry and resolved static orders pass; unresolved roundoff-limited pairs do not become a spatial qualification.
Compensated stage/endpoint clocks, two short RK policies, stable full-F assembly and explicitly measured Q versus discrete F derivative; not long-time accuracy.
Direct IPC Newton and passive root/peak diagnostics, independent full IPC audit, unchanged wall definitions and measured quadrature bias.
Native reconstruction defect, supplementary gates, cached evaluation, sparse/dense modal equivalence and includePsi behavior; no continuum certificate.
Passive exterior inflow diagnostics, declared polynomial closure, current-rate CFL formula and measured derivative-cache candidate without a speedup assumption.

Explicit reference FD manufactures and spectral zero-source comparison, default FEM identity, analytic-offset separation, native/ghost/overlap errors and four-word clock checks; not a continuum or long-trajectory qualification.
Default sparse FEM/linear5 method, Q4 Galerkin source/trace contracts, nonzero-wall smooth problem, analytic split and complete RHS; separate wall test qualifies the finite-disk corner order.
Analytic polynomial Green fields against independent image-Green quadrature and SciPy dilogarithm fixtures, including nonzero-source outer-wall corners.
Independent radial-source Green refinement with nonzero source at both outer-wall corners; full native/ghost/off-mesh velocity, raw negative control and unchanged weak/trace gates.
Explicit spectral/linear5 fixed-geometry reference spatial/Poisson/time study; qualification is separate and does not certify the new mainline.
Explicit spectral/linear5 fixed-mesh reference: three original-datum trajectories and requested time control; an unqualified study remains unqualified and is not new-mainline acceptance.
Strict fixed accepted-state Poisson refinement; requires matching current source identity, not a trajectory accuracy certificate.

Fixed-state profiled complete RHS cost; no accuracy or speedup assertion.
Exact numeric bytes against an independently frozen baseline; missing external data is skipped, never passed.
Explicit independent baseline initial/final fields, short accepted steps, complete step information and common query bytes; no order or long-time qualification.
Read-only tau200 density reevaluated using current operators; old flow is not an exact reference.
